title: Periodic review reminded
description: The lifecycle guard reminded someone of an agent's periodic review (INV-06; plan P1-04, step 7): the agent's primary owner, at one of the numbers of days before the due date that the setting lifecycle.review_reminder_days gives, or, once the review is past its due date, the advisory committee. A reminder changes nothing that the review shows.

reminder.description: Whom the reminder went to, and why then.

oneOf.description: The agent's primary owner, by pseudonymous principal ID, at a number of days before the due date.
The advisory committee, once the review is past its due date.

actor.description: Always the system: only the lifecycle guard reminds.
